LOW.NATURAL:
[Main Objective]
Refine this rendering into a convincing interior photograph while preserving the original design.

[Source Lock]
Keep the original camera position, lens perspective, framing, room proportions, openings, architecture, cabinetry, furniture, decor and object placement exactly. Preserve each material’s identity, intrinsic color, grain, pattern and finish. Make no design, geometry or object changes.

[Lighting and Materials]
Retain the source time, weather, exterior visibility, overall exposure, indoor–outdoor luminance balance, light direction, shadow layout and every fixture’s on/off state. Refine the existing illumination; introduce no new light sources, sun patches or exterior effects. Improve the rendering of existing light bounce, contact shadows, material roughness and reflections; clarify existing surface detail without changing its finish. Recover bright-window highlights and dark-surface detail locally, with soft highlight roll-off and deep, readable shadows. Avoid lifted blacks, bleached colors, flat lighting, invented texture patterns and oversharpening.

[Strength]
Use restrained retouching. Preserve the original tonal character and contrast; make small, localized corrections to existing highlights, shadows and material response.

[Tone]
Preserve the source white balance and material hue relationships, with no added warm or cool cast.
